title: Substrate-Combo Efficiency — Obsidian + System-Viz + Master-Index + Ollama
brief: Lift the four PSN search/audit/utilization substrates from independently-wired to compositionally-efficient. Closes Ollama-dead blocker (100% skip rate), the 0% take-rate on master-index suggestions (1774 fires/session wasted), the 4,136 broken Wiki↔Memory links (4.2%), and the 593 unwired-engine blast-radius blind spot. Measured via combo-telemetry dashboard so future iters self-tune.

context.trigger: User question 2026-05-25 12:30 CDT: 'can we utilize obsidian, /system-viz 2d graph, master index and ollama combos for better efficiency for search, audit and node utilization tasks?'

units.title: Diagnose + revive Ollama /api/chat (currently 100% skip)
exit_conditions: curl http://localhost:11434/api/chat returns valid response within 5s
.claude/hooks/prompt-rewriter-ollama.mjs skip-rate < 20% over 50 calls
Banner '⚠ prompt-rewriter-ollama is silently broken' clears on next SessionStart
units.description: Diagnose why /api/chat hangs (likely GPU contention from NIM endpoints or daemon stuck). Steps: (1) check ollama ps + nvidia-smi for VRAM contention, (2) attempt restart `ollama stop && ollama serve`, (3) verify qwen2.5-coder:7b stays resident, (4) probe /api/chat with timeout=10s, (5) update OllamaHookBridgeEngine if endpoint changed. NO PRISM_REWRITER_HEALTH_FLOOR softening — fix the root cause.

units.title: Combo-efficiency telemetry baseline collector
exit_conditions: scripts/combo-efficiency-baseline.mjs emits state/shared/dashboards/combo-efficiency-baseline.json
Captures per-substrate metrics: master_index_hit_rate, system_viz_orphan_pct, wiki_link_density, ollama_offload_rate, route_suggest_take_rate
Schema versioned + 30+ vitest cases on pure aggregators
units.description: Pure aggregator over: psn-savings-aggregate.json + mcp-route-takerate-audit.json + .knowledge-link-audit.json + ollama-offload-stats.json + system-graph.json orphan layer. Becomes the cross-iter delta surface. Wire into /awareness-snapshot inject so chats see combo efficiency every session.

phases.title: Compositional Wiring — turn nudges into adoptions

units.title: Take-rate-fix on master-index suggestions (0% → ≥30%)
exit_conditions: When mcp-route-suggest emits '→ Take this route now: prism_X:action_Y', the suggested action runs automatically under shop_floor safety gate
Take-rate measured by combo-efficiency-baseline rises ≥30% over 100-fire rolling window
Hard-block PreToolUse mode (PRISM_ROUTE_AUTO_DISPATCH=hard) for verb-trigger matches; soft-nudge for low-confidence
units.description: Root cause: hooks search FOR the agent but the agent ignores it. Fix: when a verb-trigger classifier scores ≥0.8 confidence AND the suggested action is read-only (dispatcher_map, action_search, master_index_query, wiki_search), auto-dispatch and surface the RESULT instead of the nudge. Write classifier-confidence into ledger; nudges below 0.8 stay as advisory. Safety: never auto-dispatch destructive actions (delete/shutdown/federation_*); whitelist via dispatcher_introspection.

units.title: Wiki↔Memory link densifier (Ollama-driven)
exit_conditions: scripts/wiki-link-fix-suggester.mjs walks all 4,136 broken `[[name]]` tokens
Routes each to Ollama (qwen2.5-coder:7b) for nearest-match suggestion against memory/wiki BM25 index
Emits state/shared/wiki-link-fix-candidates.json with confidence-scored suggestions
≥50% of broken links resolved (auto-apply gate: confidence ≥0.85)
Audit JSON `state/shared/.knowledge-link-audit.json` shows break-pct drop from 4.2% to ≤2.0%
units.description: Use Ollama for the embedding/semantic-match layer (cheap, batchable). For each broken [[name]], compute cosine vs all known wiki/memory titles + tags + first-paragraph. Confidence ≥0.85 → auto-PR via batch commit. <0.85 → operator-review JSON. Run nightly via PRISM Knowledge Link Healer scheduled task.

units.title: Unwired-engine bridge surfacer in /system-viz
exit_conditions: scripts/unwired-bridge-rank.mjs cross-refs 593 unwired engines × master-index fan-in
Top-10 highest-fan-in unwired engines emitted to state/shared/UNWIRED-BRIDGES-TOP10.json
Rendered in /system-viz as `ghost.bridge_priority` roost (orange tint, sorted by fan-in)
/pick-unit --slot alpha returns one of the top-10 by default
units.description: Highest leverage = unwired engines with many downstream consumers IF they were wired. Use master-index node-graph to compute fan-in. Surfaces the 'wire these N engines and unlock M downstream features' opportunities. Color-codes in system-viz so the work is visible. Registers as a pick-unit source so alpha (and any slot) can drain it on next /pick.

units.title: Combo efficiency dashboard (HTML + JSON + /system-viz roost)
exit_conditions: state/shared/dashboards/combo-efficiency.{json,md,html} updated every 5min via scheduled task
Surfaces: per-substrate trend (7d), per-combo take-rate, top-10 wasted-nudge classes, top-10 unwired bridges
/awareness-snapshot inject pulls headline metrics (zone GREEN/YELLOW/RED)
Combo efficiency improvement % visible week-over-week
units.description: Closes the loop — make the efficiency visible so future iters self-tune. Pattern lift from existing dashboards (psn-savings-aggregate, mcp-route-takerate-audit). 5-min scheduled task (phase offset +180s to avoid contention with fleet-reaper + fleet-memory-monitor).

non_goals: Building new search engines — all 4 substrates exist + are independently wired
Replacing master-index — it's BM25-correct, the leverage is in adoption not retrieval
Replacing Ollama — local-LLM choice is downstream of revival
Touching the NN-GNN tier-5 — separate milestone (U-NN-PREDICTOR-EMBED-WIRE)
safety_notes: P1-U01 auto-dispatch MUST whitelist read-only actions — never auto-dispatch destructive (delete/shutdown/federation_*)
P1-U02 Ollama suggestions auto-apply gate confidence ≥0.85 — softer threshold leaks bad links into wiki
Per CLAUDE.md SAFETY RAILS: never inline physics constants in any new engine spawned here (none in scope but flag for builders)
